components.name: Add selected exercises

components.name: Mobile section navigation
components.description:
The desktop sidebar contains the brand and icon-led section links. Active links use Mantine's selected treatment. Exercise discovery belongs to the add-exercise task and has no standalone navigation item. Below 48em, a floating four-item navigation links to Overview, Food, Workouts and More. More is a normal page listing secondary sections and account actions, not a sheet. The header also shows the current account role: beneath the brand name on mobile and beside the page actions on desktop. The mobile header contains the brand and page actions; the single left-aligned page title starts the content. The bar reserves content space and the device safe area, stays visible on scroll, and sits below dialogs. Theme selection (light, dark, system) lives in Settings → Appearance for both roles. Keep the skip link and current-page semantics.

Root viewport metadata uses `viewport-fit=cover` and preserves pinch zoom. Shared safe-area variables account for all four edges. The header's total height includes the top inset; main content offsets and sticky section navigation use the same height. Floating navigation reserves bottom and side safe areas. Full-screen dialog headers/bodies and bottom sheets keep their controls within safe bounds. Zero insets retain the existing desktop geometry.

narrative.overview:
This describes the incumbent application, rather than a new visual identity. Mantine supplies the component language, a teal accent marks actions and selection, and Arial keeps Russian labels and numerical content familiar. Light and dark themes share the same hierarchy.

The approved shared header gives each page one clear title and its actions. Content uses ordinary fields, restrained borders and explicit interaction states. The workout surface applies this language to a focused daily workspace; its composition and behavioral contract live in [the surface brief](docs/design/workouts-day.md), not in global branding rules.
keyCharacteristics: Mantine components with a single teal action accent.
Arial typography with compact, legible hierarchy.
Shared page heading and accessible touch controls.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use Mantine's body, text, border and primary variables in components so both themes retain their intended relationships.

rules.name: The Single Page Heading Rule
rules.body: Put the top-level page title in the shared header; use content headings only for subordinate sections.

dos: **Do** preserve the existing Mantine teal identity and both color themes.
**Do** use the shared header for page headings and primary page actions.
**Do** retain visible focus, accessible names and 44px action targets.
**Do** use semantic theme variables and readable tabular numeric fields.
donts: **Don't** introduce a new UI kit, display font or replacement brand palette in ordinary feature work.
**Don't** duplicate the page heading in the content area.
**Don't** apply workout-specific composition rules to every feature.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate a status or selection.
